events.text: In the last chamber of the Secret Realm, past a guardian's empty perch of white feathers, a staff of cloud-wood stands upright in the floor. Grey silk is wound around it and stirs slowly, as if something under the cloth were breathing. Cut at its foot: HAEWON OF THE THIRD ISLE RAISED ME AND LIVED. WHO IS NEXT.

choices.text: Draw it from the floor and take it

effects.log: It comes away easily, as if it had been waiting. Overhead the realm's sky flickers once.

choices.text: Take it, and vow to raise it only for a worthy cause

effects.log: You speak the vow aloud in the empty chamber. The silk goes still, as if listening.
You leave it standing. Whoever climbs here next will read the same question.

events.text: At the heart of the Secret Realm, behind a dead guardian's altar and its wilted offerings, a pole stands upright in the sanctum stones. Grey cloth is wound about it, moving slowly, as if the cloth were breathing. Cut at its foot: THE KEEPER OF THE SIXTH HYMN RAISED ME AND LIVED. WHO IS NEXT.

choices.text: Lift it from the stones and take it

effects.log: It comes up easily, as if it had been waiting. Somewhere in the sanctum a bell sounds once.

choices.text: Take it, and swear to raise it only in a just cause

effects.log: You make the oath aloud before the empty altar. The cloth goes still, as if listening.

choices.text: Leave it for a bolder god

effects.log: You leave it in the stones. Whoever comes next will read the same question.
